title: Board Department Reduction Sheet
source: Published FY 2021–FY 2025 expense actuals, FY 2026 original-budget rows, and FY 2027 proposed expenditures displayed by the Walton County budget site. Historical actuals and FY 2026 amounts use its deduplicated accounting layer; FY 2027 includes the site final-budget reconciliation. Fund codes are derived from the first three digits of each expense department code.
scope: Individual Board offices and programs, grouped by fund. Historical actuals and budgets are shown at the office level where available; shared accounting codes follow the published budget site deduplication. Fund and all-funds totals reconcile to the original 15-department budget controls. Other budget uses are included with Operating.
